summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) containing a Notice of Meeting and Management Information Circular for its annual and special shareholder meeting scheduled for June 15, 2026. The circular covers routine items: receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, reappointing auditors, and approving a new omnibus equity incentive plan and unallocated entitlements under the existing stock option plan. This is an ordinary AGM/EGM notice with no special-situation event; the stock option plan proposal is standard corporate governance. As a routine meeting circular, it does not constitute a special situation.
